observations.why: Declarative announcement of a switch carries energized forward-momentum; the contraction and present-continuous register a confident, enthused commitment to the change.
The 10x multiplier is an energized evaluative claim — high-arousal positive framing of the benefits.
Structured summary notation conveys settled, organized satisfaction — low-arousal positive cataloguing of the decision.
Measured restatement of the performance gain in summary form — settled, confident cataloguing without the energized delivery of the original claim.
Firm timeline pinned in summary notation conveys settled confidence — low-arousal positive commitment to a concrete date.
